description: UnitComplex and Rotation2: construction, angle, product, inverse, vector transforms, matrix conversions, rotation_between, slerp

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: unit_complex_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: unit_complex_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: unit_complex_inverse_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: unit_complex_rotation_between
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_complex_angle_to
ops.tolerance: ceil(14 + 1 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_complex_slerp
ops.doc: a.slerp(&b, t) = a * UnitComplex::new((b / a).angle() * t): shortest arc, |(b / a).angle()| < 3
ops.tolerance: ceil(32 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: rotation2_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: rotation2_transform_vector
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit
